nl: In docs/config.md, replace the exact text `The default is `sqlite://orders.db`.` with `The default is `sqlite://data/orders.db`.`. Change nothing else.

entries.content_utf8:
# Orders API

`GET /orders` returns all orders.
`POST /orders/new` creates an order.
Reference: http://example.com/orders/api

# Changelog

## 2.3.0

- Added the customers API.

## 2.2.0

- Added order export.

# Configuration

The service reads `config.toml` from the working directory.

## Database

Set `database.url`. The default is `sqlite://orders.db`.

## Logging

Set `log.level` to `debug`, `info` or `warn`.

# Orders service

See [installation](install.md) and [configuration](config.md).
Source code: http://example.com/orders/source

# Installation

Download the release from http://example.com/orders/releases.
Verify the checksum published at http://example.com/orders/sha256.

## Requirements

- Linux, macOS or Windows
- 512 MB of memory

docs/config.md.text:
# Configuration

The service reads `config.toml` from the working directory.

## Database

Set `database.url`. The default is `sqlite://data/orders.db`.

## Logging

Set `log.level` to `debug`, `info` or `warn`.

oracle_program: replace "The default is `sqlite://orders.db`." "The default is `sqlite://data/orders.db`." in: ["docs/config.md"] mode: literal expect: 1
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('docs/config.md')
t = p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
old = 'The default is `sqlite://orders.db`.'
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_bytes(t.replace(old, 'The default is `sqlite://data/orders.db`.').encode('utf-8'))
EOF
reference_pwsh:
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'docs/config.md'
$t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$old = 'The default is `sqlite://orders.db`.'
$new = 'The default is `sqlite://data/orders.db`.'
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($old))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'expected one match' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace($old, $new))
